description: Background images for VS Code: full window or per part, with presets, rotation and live updates.
config.enabled: Show background images. Turning this on for the first time installs UshiroE's patch into VS Code and asks you to restart VS Code.
config.mode.fullscreen: One image over the whole window.
config.mode.parts: Separate images for the editor, side bars and panel.
config.sources: Images that areas can use: a file, a folder or an `http(s)://` URL. Files and folders are copied into the image folder (`#ushiroe.libraryFolder#`) once, when they are added, and are not linked to the original afterwards. Supported formats: PNG, JPEG, GIF, BMP, SVG and WebP.
config.source.id: Unique id that areas refer to.
config.source.name: Display name.
config.source.path: Where the images were imported from, or the URL that is downloaded. Changing it imports the source again.
config.source.recursive: Whether subfolders were included when the folder was imported.
config.fullscreen: Background for the whole window, used when `#ushiroe.mode#` is `fullscreen`.
config.editor: Background for the editor area, used when `#ushiroe.mode#` is `parts`.
config.sidebar: Background for the primary side bar, used when `#ushiroe.mode#` is `parts`.
config.auxiliaryBar: Background for the secondary side bar, used when `#ushiroe.mode#` is `parts`.
config.panel: Background for the panel, used when `#ushiroe.mode#` is `parts`.
config.area.enabled: Draw a background in this part.
config.area.source: What to show: a source id, `*` for all images, `preset:<id>` for a preset, or nothing.
config.area.opacity: How visible the image is, from 0 to 1.
config.area.size: How the image fits the area.
config.area.position: CSS background-position, such as `center` or `right bottom`.
config.transition: Seconds the cross-fade between rotating images takes.
config.patch.hideCorruptWarning: Update VS Code's checksum for the patched file so that VS Code does not report the installation as corrupt. UshiroE only does this for files it verified, and puts VS Code's own checksum back when the patch is removed.
config.patch.autoRepair: Re-apply the patch automatically when VS Code was updated and the patch is gone.
config.source.refresh.never: Once, when the source is added. Use Download Again to update it.
config.source.refresh.startup: Again at every startup, so changes at the URL show up.
config.presets: Your own lists of images. Create and edit them in the UshiroE view, then choose one as an area's image.
config.libraryFolder: Folder UshiroE keeps the images in, one subfolder per source. Images you put into a source's subfolder are shown too. Leave empty to use `UshiroE` in your Pictures folder. Changing it imports the sources again; the old folder is kept.
config.backImage.priority: Which extension manages the background when BackImage is also installed. Both change the same VS Code files, so only one may do it at a time.
config.backImage.priority.ushiroe: UshiroE manages it. While BackImage is active, UshiroE changes nothing and asks you to uninstall or disable BackImage.
config.backImage.priority.backImage: BackImage manages it while it is active. UshiroE changes nothing and does not repair its patch.
config.allImages: How All images (`*`) takes turns. It plays every source's images in the order of the source list.
config.preset.images: Images in play order, each as `<source id>/<file name>`.
config.rotation.random: Pick the next image at random instead of from top to bottom.
config.rotation.interval: Seconds between images. 0 keeps showing the same image.
config.rotation.changeOnStartupOnly: Change the image only when VS Code starts: each start shows the next image, or a random one.
